mission.title: trickster: Custom paths not effective
mission.description: Custom paths not effective. Community-requested feature.

steps.title: Check current trickster deployment
steps.description:
Verify your trickster version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n trickster -l app.kubernetes.io/name=trickster
helm list -n trickster 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working trickster installation.

steps.title: Review trickster configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant trickster configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n trickster -l app.kubernetes.io/name=trickster
kubectl get configmap -n trickster -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=trickster
```
Hi，
   I tested paths functionality by referring to the profile of paths.md.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Custom paths not effective
steps.description:
The `SetDefaults` function now copies over custom paths to the returned options by iterating the "old" routes (after they've had their own SetDefaults called) and setting the value for each key to a clone of the "old" value.

This was brought to my attention in issue #671, and my testing indicates that it resolves that issue; however, due to issues with the posted config (happens with copying over sometimes), my test wasn't an exact replica, so I will wait to hear from the issue creator. #655

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n trickster -l app.kubernetes.io/name=trickster
kubectl get events -n trickster --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Custom paths not effective" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: The `SetDefaults` function now copies over custom paths to the returned options by iterating the "old" routes (after they've had their own SetDefaults called) and setting the value for each key to a clone of the "old" value.

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with trickster installed or the issue environment reproducible.
